hook.name: SwapFeeHook
hook.description: The single Uniswap v4 hook for the gwei.fun launchpad. In beforeSwap, it charges a configurable fee (platform fee plus optional per-pool creator tax with linear anti-snipe decay) on the specified currency, holding collected amounts as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager for lazy redemption by creators and a buyback vault. Pools must be pre-registered before initialization.
